title: Review
subtitle: What Kredibel could not settle on its own. Each fix is saved with your name and the month is reconciled again.
empty: Nothing to review. Every month's exceptions are settled.

why.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: Its values are kept out of the month until you decide. Compare it with the earlier document.
why.PROPOSED_MATCH: Kredibel only matches on its own when one answer is clearly better, so this one is yours.
why.UNMATCHED_DOCUMENT: The bank statements cover its payment window and show no payment for it.
why.UNMATCHED_BANK_LINE: A check names this line and no document supports it.
why.LOW_CONFIDENCE_VALUE: Only one reading supports this value, or two readings disagree. Check it on the page.
why.LEDGER_DIFFERENCE: The ledger and the bank disagree for this month.
why.CONFIRM_TYPE: Kredibel is not sure what kind of document this is.
why.CONFIRM_LEDGER_MAPPING: This ledger layout is new. Check which column is which.
